description:
Return the mobile devices brands for which we have battery statistics,
along with the number of distinct models, the number of devices recorded per brand,
and the largest single-model device count within the brand (`max_devices_per_model`).
Each entry also includes a `url` to the public BatterySnap web page for the brand
(e.g. https://www.battery-snap.com/brands/samsung).
Pass `min_device_count` / `max_device_count` and `min_model_count` / `max_model_count`
to filter brands by recorded-device and distinct-model counts.
Pass `fields` to keep only specific attributes in each entry.
The full list is long: pass `limit` (and `offset` to page) unless you really
need every brand, and prefer `search` when resolving one brand by name.

fields.description: Optional whitelist of attribute names to keep in each returned entry, used to shrink the response. When omitted or empty, all attributes documented in the output schema are returned. Unknown names are silently ignored.

limit.description: Return at most this many entries. Omit for no cap — but the unbounded list can be very large, so prefer a limit.

max_device_count.description: Drop entries with more than this many recorded devices. Use to skip very common entries. Omit for no upper bound.

max_model_count.description: Drop brands with more than this many distinct models. Omit for no upper bound.

min_device_count.description: Drop entries with fewer than this many recorded devices. Defaults to 1 (keep all).

min_model_count.description: Drop brands with fewer than this many distinct models. Defaults to 0 (keep all).

offset.description: Skip this many entries before returning results — use with `limit` to page through a long list. Defaults to 0.

name: brands

device_count.description: Number of individual devices of this brand that reported battery snapshots.

max_devices_per_model.description: Largest number of devices recorded for a single model within this brand (the most popular model's device count). 0 when the brand has no device with a known model.

model_count.description: Number of distinct device models recorded for this brand.

url.description: Public BatterySnap web page listing this brand's models and devices. Locale-agnostic — the server 301-redirects to the visitor's detected locale.

title: List brands
